answer: Dispute escrow makes fraud expensive: a newcomer locks 240 units 15 epochs; anyone may challenge within 3 epochs, with 9 jurors ruling in 2. Proven fraud slashes 80%, a quarter rewarding the challenger, and bars the fraud 12 epochs; a trellis of records exposes repeats. A nebula of funding checks flags clusters, and a jade-marked record earns rebates: 1,000 fakes lock 240,000 units; with 30% caught the farm loses 57,600, challengers earn 14,400.
